scenario.organization_context: Healthcare staffing agency, 300 staff. HR coordinates quarterly payroll compliance verifications via BambooHR.

simulation.subject: Action Required: Q3 Payroll Compliance Verification - BambooHR Update
simulation.body:
Dear HR Team,

As part of our upcoming quarterly audit, we need all HR personnel to complete the Q3 payroll compliance verification for our healthcare staffing personnel records.

Please review and sign off on the updated staff classification guidelines via the secure portal below by end of day tomorrow to ensure compliance with our agency standards.

[SIMULATED LINK: Access BambooHR Compliance Portal]

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Director of People Operations
People & Culture Department

metadata.difficulty_rationale: Difficulty 2 is achieved by using an external domain disguised as BambooHR and a moderate urgency timeframe, which a moderately attentive reader can spot upon inspecting the sender address.
metadata.scenario_notes: Tailored for healthcare staffing HR context using BambooHR terminology without real domains.

semantic_findings: The sender domain suffix 'example-corp-sim.local' explicitly signals a simulation domain, making it overly obvious if previewed closely.
